participation.context: Played Egeon, and did not cross the water.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the title and your side. You played. You read the Rose's bill and stayed for the reckoning.

title: Played Egeon and stayed for the reckoning

participation.context: Took the stack, and did not rule it into the coffer.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Read the week on the line, and set the share at thirty-four.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Kept the sum on its own line, and would not have the foot flatter the week.
participation.name: Humphrey Larkham

participation.context: Asked for the figure plain, and kept Tuesday's name out of the book.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Kept the grain out of the column.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Took the shillings, and sent him home to sleep.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Told the share out with the name, and did not short it for the tooth.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You heard the share, you looked at the count, and you took it home unruled. The ship stayed off the line. The coffer stayed at home.
